T: From zero to hero to second helpings.
D: The son of Zeus, raised on Earth, trains to become a true hero and win back his place on Olympus.
P: Serve the feast when Hercules returns to Mount Olympus.
S: Spinach and feta with dill, spring onion and egg, wrapped in buttered filo triangles, baked at 190C for 25 minutes until golden.

Little lamb meatballs with mint, oregano and feta, pan-fried until crusty and served on skewers with cool garlic tzatziki and lemon. Mix 500g lamb mince with 1 grated onion, 1 egg, 40g fresh breadcrumbs, 60g crumbled feta, chopped mint, 1 tsp dried oregano and salt. Roll into 24 balls and fry in olive oil for 8 to 10 minutes, turning, until browned and cooked through. Grate 1 Lebanese cucumber, squeeze dry and mix with 250g Greek yoghurt, 1 grated garlic clove, lemon and dill. Serve the keftedes on skewers with the tzatziki.
the monster that grows more heads
Haloumi sliced and griddled until golden, drizzled with honey and chilli, more slices added as fast as they're eaten.
M: a feast fit for the gods on Mount Olympus
Lamb leg cubes marinated in lemon, garlic and oregano, skewered and grilled hot, with pita, tzatziki, tomato and red onion.
the god of the underworld with the flaming hair

King prawns baked in a bubbling chilli, garlic and tomato sauce with crumbled feta, served with crusty bread and a lemony orzo. Heat the oven to 200C. Soften 1 diced onion and 4 sliced garlic cloves in olive oil, add 1 tsp chilli flakes and 1 chopped red chilli, then 1 tin crushed tomatoes and oregano and simmer 10 minutes. Stir in 800g peeled green king prawns, tip into a baking dish, crumble 150g feta over and bake 10 minutes. Cook 300g orzo and toss with lemon zest, butter and parsley. Serve with crusty bread.
W: Yeasted batter spooned into hot oil at 175C, fried until puffed and golden, soaked in warm honey and cinnamon, sprinkled with walnuts.
K: Olympus golden peach and honey fizz

Peach nectar shaken with honey, lemon and a little orange blossom water, topped with sparkling water and served golden over ice with mint. Stir 2 tbsp honey into 2 tbsp warm water until dissolved. In a jug mix 600ml peach nectar, the honey water, the juice of a lemon and half a teaspoon of orange blossom water. Fill 4 glasses with ice and fresh peach slices, pour in the nectar to two thirds and top with chilled sparkling water. Add a mint sprig.

s.how: Wilt 400g spinach, squeeze dry and chop. Mix with 200g feta, chopped dill, 3 spring onions and 1 egg. Cut 6 sheets filo into strips, brush with 60g melted butter, add a spoon of filling and fold into triangles. Bake at 190C for 25 minutes.

s.note: the monster that grows more heads
s.how: Slice 2 blocks of haloumi, about 500g, into thick pieces. Griddle in a hot dry pan for 2 minutes a side until golden. Drizzle with honey, sprinkle with chilli flakes and thyme, and squeeze over lemon. Cook more as fast as it disappears.

m.note: a feast fit for the gods on Mount Olympus
m.how: Marinate 1kg diced lamb leg in lemon juice, 3 garlic cloves, 2 tsp oregano and oil for 2 hours. Thread onto skewers and grill hot. Mix 300g Greek yoghurt with grated cucumber and garlic. Serve in 4 warm pita with tomato and red onion.

w.how: Mix 250g flour, 7g yeast, a pinch of salt and 300ml warm water to a thick batter and rest an hour. Drop spoonfuls into 175C oil and fry until puffed and golden. Toss in 150g warm honey with cinnamon and scatter over 60g chopped walnuts.

d.n: Olympus golden peach and honey fizz

Fill 4 glasses with ice and fresh peach slices, pour in the nectar to two thirds and top with chilled sparkling water. Add a mint sprig.
